SELECT c.company_name, r2025.revenue - r2024.revenue AS revenue_diff FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r2025 JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r2024 ON r2025.company_id = r2024.company_id AND r2024.tax_year = 2024 JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r2025.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r2025.tax_year = 2025;

SELECT c.company_name FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r ON c.company_id = r.company_id WHERE rt.type_name = '港澳台商投资企业' ORDER BY r.revenue DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT i.industry_name, COUNT(*) AS private_company_count FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE c.is_private = TRUE GROUP BY i.industry_name;

SELECT (f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares AS bps FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '贵州茅台' AND f.report_date = '2025-03-31';

SELECT s.stock_name, (MAX(t.high_price) - MIN(t.low_price)) / AVG(t.close_price) AS volatility_ratio FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.stock_name;

SELECT s.stock_name, (t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares)) AS pb FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31' ORDER BY pb DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT AVG(revenue - non_taxable_income - deductions - prior_year_losses) AS avg_taxable_income FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns WHERE tax_year = 2025

SELECT (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.10 AS tax_saved FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '腾讯控股' AND r.tax_year = 2024;

SELECT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.25 / r.revenue) * 100 AS tax_burden FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '中国中车' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

SELECT (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 - (SELECT AVG((f2.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s2.current_price * 100) FROM finance_tax.stocks s2 JOIN finance_tax.companies c2 ON s2.company_id = c2.company_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f2 ON s2.company_id = f2.company_id WHERE c2.industry_code = (SELECT c.industry_code FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON s.company_id = c.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '中国石化') AND f2.report_date = '2025-12-31') AS diff_pct FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '中国石化' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31'
SELECT c.company_name FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.non_taxable_income / r.revenue > 0.5;

SELECT i.industry_name, AVG(CASE WHEN c.is_private = TRUE THEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech OR c.is_tech_advanced_service THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END END) AS avg_private_tax, AVG(CASE WHEN c.is_private = FALSE THEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech OR c.is_tech_advanced_service THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END END) AS avg_state_tax FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 GROUP BY i.industry_name

SELECT s.stock_name, STDDEV((t.close_price - t.open_price) / t.open_price) * SQRT(250) * 100 AS annual_volatility FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.stock_name;

SELECT s.stock_name, (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 AS dy FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON s.company_id = c.company_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND (f.dividend_stock / 100.0) / s.current_price * 100 > (SELECT AVG(f2.dividend_stock / 100.0 / s2.current_price * 100) FROM finance_tax.stocks s2 JOIN finance_tax.companies c2 ON s2.company_id = c2.company_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f2 ON s2.company_id = f2.company_id WHERE f2.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND c2.industry_code = c.industry_code);

SELECT r.semester_id, r.academic_year, r.semester_code, r.start_date_key, r.end_date_key, 2025 AS _source_year FROM education_2025.semester r 
UNION ALL
SELECT r.semester_id, r.academic_year, r.semester_code, r.start_date_key, r.end_date_key, 2024 AS _source_year FROM education_2024.semester r 
),
_edu_semester_ranked AS (SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(r.academic_year, ''), CONCAT('__unmapped:',r._source_year,':',r.semester_id)), COALESCE(NULLIF(r.semester_code, ''), CONCAT('__unmapped:',r._source_year,':',r.semester_id)) ORDER BY r._source_year DESC, r.semester_id DESC) AS _merge_rank FROM _edu_semester_rows r),
edu_semester AS (SELECT r.semester_id, r.academic_year, r.semester_code, r.start_date_key, r.end_date_key, r._source_year FROM _edu_semester_ranked r  WHERE r._merge_rank=1)
SELECT sem.semester_code, sem.start_date_key, sem.end_date_key FROM edu_semester sem ORDER BY sem.academic_year ASC LIMIT 10

),
_edu_teacher_ranked AS (SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(r.teacher_no, ''), CONCAT('__unmapped:',r._source_year,':',r.teacher_id)) ORDER BY r._source_year DESC, r.teacher_id DESC) AS _merge_rank FROM _edu_teacher_rows r),

),
